finding.title: The lab executes a stale local build, not the adopted TCLK pin
finding.summary: lab/upstream.mjs verifies the upstream clone's HEAD against evidence/upstream-baseline.json and then imports .upstream/tclk/dist/index.js. The SHA check covers the clone; the import resolves a build artifact. Upstream gitignores dist/, so nothing ties the two together. The clone is exactly on the pin while dist/ is the compiled output of a commit before upstream 103a1b960c117c82473ee058b7dca1769e167125 ('fix: close live-wire conformance gaps', #42), which is an ancestor of the pin.

blastRadius.consequence: Every canonical frame, state transition, replay trajectory and hash this lab has produced under the d48e873 label came out of the stale artifact, not out of the pinned sources.

phase3b1DeliverablesWithheld.reason: Parts 7, 8, 10, 15, 16 and 18 all require byte-exact behaviour of the adopted TCLK implementation. Producing them against an artifact of unknown provenance would mint hashes that look authoritative and are not.
notWithheld: the pinned-source protocol reconfirmation (Part 1), which was read from src/ at the pin and agrees with Phase 3B.0
the read-only integrity probe and its regression assertion

part1Reconfirmation.readFrom: pinned sources at d48e873 (src/frames.ts, src/machine.ts, src/frame-fields.generated.ts), not from docs and not from the built artifact
part1Reconfirmation.note: src/frames.ts also carries 'job' and 'presig' type literals, but src/machine.ts dispatches on exactly the eight frames above, so the state-changing frame set is unchanged from Phase 3B.0.

provenanceCorrection.regressionAssertion: blackbox/tests/phase3b1.test.mjs pins the two provenance roles to distinct, exact SHAs and fails if they are ever conflated.

didBSigningRoute.reAuditNote: Part 14 was not re-proved from canonical signer source in this phase: the phase halted at the pin-build gate before reaching it. The prior recorded model is identitySelectionModel=ROOT_SCOPED_INTERNAL_PRIMITIVE with a reviewed named-profile ENROLLMENT entrypoint and no proven named-profile SIGNING entrypoint.

remediationOrder: Human decides how the pin is to be made executable: rebuild .upstream/tclk from the pinned commit, or consume the pin's sources directly instead of dist/.
Make dist/ provenance checkable rather than assumed: lab/upstream.mjs must fail closed when the artifact does not correspond to the verified clone HEAD.
Re-run the existing Blackbox suite against the corrected artifact and record which previously recorded hashes and trajectories move.
Only then re-attempt the Phase 3B.1 exact manifest freeze.
limitations: This artifact records why the Phase 3B.1 freeze did not happen. It is not a frozen manifest and contains no canonical frame hash, no template hash and no manifest root.

The probe compares the pinned sources against the built artifact by static text analysis. It establishes non-correspondence, which is sufficient to block a byte-exact freeze; it does not enumerate every behavioural difference, and the observed frame-field deltas are a lower bound.
The probe deliberately does not import the built artifact, so it cannot report differences that exist only in runtime behaviour.
No claim is made here about which of the previously recorded Blackbox hashes are wrong. That requires a rebuild and a re-run, which is a human decision because it changes recorded evidence.
nextRecommendedAction: Human: decide the pin-build remediation, then re-run Phase 3B.1 from Part 1.
blockReasonNote: Not TCLK_PHASE3B1_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH: the pinned protocol sources still agree with the Phase 3B.0 conclusions. What mismatches is the locally built artifact the lab executes.
